headline: UK rail facial recognition trial cost £320K, yielded one false alert
summary: A six-month trial of live facial recognition technology on London's rail network cost about £320,000 and used almost 100 hours of police officers' time. Outlets agree it produced one alert, a false positive, with no genuine matches or arrests.
